verdict.rationale: Factory has Slack integration (factory-docs-4) which implies some notification channel, and cloud session sync (factory-docs-19) suggests sessions can be checked from anywhere, but there is no documented explicit notification system (e.g., push/email alerts) for task completion or when input is needed. missing for 10: explicit notification/alert documentation for task completion or approval requests, evidence of how Slack integration triggers notifications, confirmation of any in-app or email alerting mechanism.
